description: Permanent registry of external GitHub repositories and card databases referenced for Yu-Gi-Oh! Power of Chaos Remake card data and effect scripting.

repositories.name: Project Ignis / EDOPro CardScripts
repositories.purpose: Official EDOPro Lua scripts (c<passcode>.lua) defining activation conditions, costs, targets, and operations for 13,000+ cards.

repositories.name: Project Ignis BabelCDB
repositories.purpose: SQLite (.cdb) databases containing card stats, passcodes, names, effect texts, and string tables matching CardScripts.

repositories.name: YGOJSON (Aggregate Card Database)
repositories.purpose: Aggregated single-file JSON database of Yu-Gi-Oh! card metadata, localized names, stats, and effect texts.

repositories.name: YGOPRODeck Card Info JSON API v7
repositories.purpose: Direct JSON dump of 13,000+ Yu-Gi-Oh! cards with full metadata, passcodes, and artwork URLs.
usage_rules: Download and bundle card images locally in the project assets rather than hotlinking YGOPRODeck image URLs at runtime to prevent IP bans and ensure offline functionality.
Attach aggregated JSON snapshots or Lua script batches directly to workspace when importing new card sets.
